description: Are you a homebrewer looking for some top of the line bottles for your creations? Look no further than

16 Ounce Bottles  6 Bottles Per Case  Clear Color  Thicker / stronger glass than typical 12 oz beer bottles  Completely reusable  Flip-top style: simplifies bottling process  No need to cap  Sturdy, steel wire assembly and thick rubber gaskets to complete the seal  Also known as grolsch-style beer bottles
